gate_reason: At 69.4% Low confidence (84 of 121 scored claims), Stage 4 sits just below the 70% re-run threshold but carries systemic source quality problems that materially undermine the document's evidentiary value. The most critical failures are: (1) The RTTVP market sizing ($3.2B-$4.2B) is sourced only from openpr.com and Valuates — both are re-publishers, not independent research firms — which means the category's own addressable market has no specialist primary validation. (2) The 1,475% strategic cargo theft rise (PP4.1) and 66→576 fictitious pickup statistics (PP4.1) — both central to the GPS-jamming / spot-carrier risk framing — are sourced from insurance industry content marketing (Travelers, Burns & Wilcox, HaulerHub blog) with no Verisk CargoNet or TT Club primary citation. (3) The $35B pharma cold chain loss figure (PP4.2) is accessed only via a sensor vendor's blog, not the IQVIA Institute primary. (4) The suspicious domain research.oz.spotlightar.com (PP4.4-6) is cited for a Gartner 2025 MQ claim and appears to be an SEO scraper — this citation must be removed. (5) The ASSUMED tags are used appropriately (12 instances properly disclosed) but create a high floor of structural uncertainty about SEA presence claims for every vendor profiled. The gate decision is ship-with-flag rather than re-run because: the vendor profiles (funding rounds, acquisitions, named customers) are correctly sourced from primary press releases and constitute reliable M-confidence factual claims; the Gartner MQ Leadership positions are corroborated by multiple competing vendor PRs; and Berg Insight is directly cited for the reefer tracker metric. The three highest-priority deep research targets are: (a) Verisk CargoNet primary for 1,475% strategic theft rise and 66→576 fictitious pickups; (b) IQVIA Institute primary for $35B pharma cold chain loss; (c) specialist primary research firm (Berg Insight, ABI Research, IDC) for RTTVP market size. Resolving these three would lift 8-10 Low claims to Medium, potentially crossing back below the 30% Low threshold on re-validation.
